description: One QRdx docs page as Markdown, by its path from search_docs (/docs/developers/mcp) or its URL. Long pages are cut at 12,000 characters with a link to the rest. Pages are in English.

language.description: Ignored. The docs are in English only, so results always come back in English. Accepted so that callers written while the docs were translated keep working.

path.description: The page's path from search_docs, such as /docs/developers/rest-api, or its full URL.

title: Read a QRdx docs page
